items.title: Last day to file Widerspruch against the care grade decision (Pflegegrad 2 instead of 3)
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 2025-03-28, assumed posted that day. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a posted notice counts as delivered on the third day after posting: 2025-03-31 (Monday). Period of one month starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 2025-04-01. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends on 2025-05-01. That is a Thursday and a public holiday (Tag der Arbeit), so under § 26 SGB X / § 193 BGB the period ends on the next working day, Friday 2025-05-02.

warnings: The posting date is not stated; the deadline assumes the letter was mailed on its date, 28.03.2025. If it was mailed later, the deadline moves later. To be safe, file the Widerspruch well before 02.05.2025.
